messages:
claire (PM): ACME follow-up: they want a bounded "burst" commitment for their reserved pool, plus a simple autoscale hook we can expose. They asked for a short pilot contract window. Can we outline a safe pilot scope today? cc @anne @raj @olivia

anne (Eng): Quick: do they need token-level latency guarantees or just low error-rate under load? Different work.

raj (Infra): Their note emphasized avoiding 5xx spikes. We can deliver: operator-facing YAML for triggers + an HTTP prewarm webhook. Minimal impl: ~2 sprints.

olivia (SRE): Important: call it a "pilot target," not an SLA. We need fallback (spill to hosted) and a canary with rollback thresholds before promising numbers.

sam (Support): ACME also wants per-request logs for debugging during pilot. We can share read-only dashboards and facsimile logs; retention needs confirming.

claire (PM): Proposed pilot scope (minimal):
- Autoscale trigger YAML + webhook prewarm
- Canary cutover plan with auto-fallback to hosted variant on errors
- Pilot acceptance checklist (load & chaos tests)
- Access to telemetry for ACME (read-only)

anne (Eng): Works. If we avoid a product UI and keep config to YAML, we cut delivery time. Estimate: 6 dev-weeks total (design + impl + tests).

raj (Infra): Config sketch for ticket:
```
autoscale:
  metric: queue_depth_p95
  threshold: 100
  prewarm: 1-gpu
  cooldown: 300s
```
Wireable to prewarm service.

olivia (SRE): Checklist highlights: 2x burst load test, chaos (GPU/region fail), canary ramp & rollback, alerts for error-rate/queue/tail-latency.

marco (Legal): Don't advertise SLA numbers outside an amendment. Call any metric a pilot objective; Legal will draft language if ACME requests a formal SLA.

claire (PM): Good. I'll present as pilot objective. Next actions: @anne add JIRA estimates by EOD, @raj push config mock, @olivia start test harness skeleton, @sam confirm log retention with ACME. Reconvene Fri 10am.

deploy-bot: ticket PIOT-400 created by @claire: "ACME reserved pool pilot - autoscale hook + canary"

anne (Eng): Adding estimates now.

olivia (SRE): Will share benchmark plan Wed.

sam (Support): Will confirm logging requirements with ACME and schedule coverage.

claire (PM): Thanks all, closing loop.
